sections.html: The versatility of X-Seal expandable foam tape makes it perfect for sealing any shaped gap in the construction of metal buildings, doors and windows, concrete, wood and more. It has excellent compressibility and recovery (for minimal compression set), and its UV-stable design maintains a seal during thermal expansion and contraction of building panels. An ideal thermal and sound insulator, X-Seal is able to hold the exterior out and the interior in while allowing vapors to move through. A hermetic seal allows the absorption of moisture and when conditions permit, the slow release of moisture through evaporation. With X-Seal, there’s no shrinkage or blow-out from closed-cell breakage and no worry about drying out or becoming hard and brittle.

• Description/Base/Color: Pre-compressed, self-expanding PUR foam impregnated with a high-quality modified acrylic, flame retardant emulsion. The base foam is black; other colors available.
  • Density: 10 lbs./cu ft. (150kg/m3)
  • Flammability: UL 94 HF1,
  • Self-extinguishing, DIN 4102, B1 compression at 50%, B2 compressed
  • Temperature Stability Range: -40°F to 212°F
  • Manufacturer’s Lab: -40°C to 120°C
  • Weather Resistancy: Excellent
  • Compression Set: Maximum 2%
  • Tensile Strength: 21.8 psi
